description: Free up to 10 pages a day per client address, no key needed; sample report: https://difficat.com/agents/sample/report.json. Compares Site A against Site B on page existence, content and visual regression, priced on the pages it compares. Call it for a migration or redesign check: sourceUrl and targetUrl let discovery pick the pages (maxPages caps them), or urls names the pairs; then wait_for_comparison until it ends and get_report with failedOnly: true. Not for one page you only want to see: that is capture_screenshot. dryRun: true answers the page count and price (0.02 USD a page, 0.01 beyond 1000) without charging; a job above the remaining free allowance is refused with a payment challenge carrying nextSteps for your human. maxPriceUsd refuses a dearer job before any challenge. Example: { "urls": [{ "source": "https://old.example/a", "target": "https://new.example/a" }] }. Answers with jobId, jobToken, status, pagesCharged and, on a free run, sample and allowanceRemaining.

callbackUrl.description: Optional https URL (port 443) that receives one JSON POST when the job ends (jobId, status, summary, links; never the jobToken), a nudge to read the job. Public hosts only, no redirects followed, retried twice; delivery never affects the job.

checkMode.description: What each page is checked on: full (existence, content and visual, the default) or text-only (existence and content, no screenshots).

dryRun.description: Quote only: runs every check and the pricing, then answers the page count and exact amount. Nothing is charged, the free allowance is not used and no job starts; the same body without dryRun is priced from the retained result.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional opaque string a retry repeats: under a prepaid balance the same value within 24 hours is not charged again and answers DUPLICATE_REQUEST with the jobId of the first call.

maxPages.description: Optional ceiling on the pages compared and charged for. The job is priced on the pages it compares: the urls list, or the pages discovery finds, at most this many. There is no page limit.

maxPriceUsd.description: Optional spend cap in USD. A job priced above it is refused before any challenge, so an auto-paying client is never asked for more.

sourceAuth.description: HTTP basic auth for Site A.

sourceUrl.description: Site A, the reference site (full URL). Required unless urls is given.

targetAuth.description: HTTP basic auth for Site B.

targetUrl.description: Site B, the migrated site. Omit to capture screenshots of Site A only.

threshold.description: Visual diff tolerance as a fraction from 0 (exact) to 1: 0.05 means 5%. The web app takes a percentage; the API does not.

urls.description: Explicit page pairs to compare (at most 50000); skips discovery and is priced per pair. One pair is a single-page comparison and needs no sourceUrl.

target.description: The same page's URL on Site B.
